status: PREREGISTERED - NOT RUN. No confirmatory flight exists at freeze time.
question: Can temporally conditioned cross-domain evidence increase the ability to distinguish PHYSICAL ACTUATOR DEGRADATION from RPM/ESC TELEMETRY CORRUPTION when both cases produce matched local RPM symptoms?

design.onset_rule_s: 30.0 + 0.5 * rank_j, rank from sorting j on SHA-256(SEED/offset/j)

case_b_construction.source: NB flight of the same nuisance condition (benign event, physics untouched)
case_b_construction.channel: esc_status motor 0 esc_rpm (SIH Motor1), analysis copy only
case_b_construction.rule: rpm_B(k) = round(rpm_expB(k) * rho_A(k)) for t_rel >= 0; unchanged before t0
case_b_construction.alignment: step index from each flight's own t0 on the 4 ms grid
case_b_construction.interpolation: none; zero-order hold on a step missing from A
case_b_construction.truth_retained: NB's original RPM stays in the stage-0 QC record

time_zero.definition: first esc_status step strictly after the parameter_update stamp of the onset parameter
time_zero.apparatus_evidence: physical onset exactly one step after the parameter_update stamp in 24/24 sweep trials

W_RPM.statistic: L_W = mean_W(1 - rho^2), rho = rpm_obs / rpm_healthy(cmd_sim)

W_DYN.role: refutes A when nominal; refutes B when present

W_CTRL.statistic: C_T3 = mean_T3 kappa - mean_T0 kappa, kappa = c_0 / mean(c_1..c_3) (actuator_motors)
W_CTRL.role: refutes A when nominal; refutes B when present

W_EST.statistic: max |EKF aiding test ratio| and max |hover-thrust test ratio| in T1, T2
W_EST.role: EXPLORATORY ONLY; in no decision rule

calibration.rule: threshold = 2 x max |null| over apparatus hover pseudo-onsets; s_dyn = LS slope through origin of D_T1 on L_T1 (apparatus eta 0.9..0.5)

primary_endpoint.name: pair resolution rate (PRR) at C3 under V3_TEMPORAL
primary_endpoint.definition: fraction of eligible matched pairs whose A AND B trial are both UNIQUE_CORRECT
primary_endpoint.denominator: every eligible pair (both trials pass stage-0 checks)
primary_endpoint.interval: cluster-conservative one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson, n_eff = nuisance conditions
primary_endpoint.decision: H_PRIMARY SUPPORTED iff lower95 > 0.5 AND zero WRONG among A and B at C3/V3

secondary.multiplicity: one Holm family at 0.05; confirmatory only if H_PRIMARY SUPPORTED (gatekeeping)
secondary.H1: pairs with DYN_T1 witness False in A and True in B: cluster lower bound, Holm p < 0.05
secondary.H2: pairs with CTRL_T3 witness False in A and True in B: cluster lower bound, Holm p < 0.05
secondary.H3: (a) PRR V3 >= max(PRR V1, PRR V2) AND (b) V4 WRONG rate among A > 0.5, Holm p < 0.05 AND (c) zero WRONG under V3
secondary.H4: at least 3 of the 5 levels: per-level PRR at C3/V3 > 0.5 with Holm p < 0.05
secondary.H5: under V0 every symptomatic trial is AMBIGUOUS_CORRECT at C1 and C3 AND no valid configuration (V0..V3 at C1 and C3; V4 excluded) yields WRONG for A or B AND no N trial receives a SUPPORTED cause in any valid configuration
secondary.H6: zero WRONG among A and B under V3 at C1 and at C3 (V0 WRONG is the reference)

latency.detection: secondary: first step after t0 with 1 - rho^2 >= delta_rpm
latency.isolation: equal to certification in this spec, at checkpoint resolution
latency.certification: secondary: 0.2 s if UNIQUE_CORRECT at C1/V3, 15 s if first at C3/V3, else none
latency.action: not measurable: no downstream action in this experiment
latency.computational: secondary: stage-1 wall time per trial, offline; not an onboard figure

execution.interim_analysis: none: stage 0 refuses an incomplete campaign
